name: ai-flight
title: AI pilot: first flight
description: An AI pilot (for now a computer built into the ship) flies a second Gunship 2 over the base, through its own channels (e1.*), as a player would. It learned the ship from its design: which way each engine pushes and how it turns the ship; how hard is corrected in flight. The timeline gives it goals: hover, fly right at 6 m/s, turn and fly left, point the nose at the horizon, and hover again. Your own ship waits on the pad. Flight skill sets how hard it manoeuvres and how closely it holds its goal.

ui.lookFor: Watch the AI ship (e1) above the base: it hovers, flies right, turns round and flies back, points its nose at the horizon, then hovers. Select its hull to see the pilot's intent, commands and the thrust it has learned. Try the flight skill slider.
